text:
anya: Quick sync — private/on‑prem networking runway. Customer asks piling up: preserve egress IP, optional relay for behind-NAT sites, and minimal KMS hookups. We need to decide what lands in the MVP vs. later.

mike: +1. From sales: 3 enterprise pilots need IP preservation and a simple egress whitelist by EOW. They said no full BGP peering yet, just static egress mapping.

sarah: For MVP we can scope to: (1) operator relay (optional), (2) static egress IP mapping, (3) /preflight checks for firewall rules, and (4) KMS integration stub. Anything else is scope creep.

noah: Agree. Also call out observability: we need token-level latency/cost traces even for private deployments (customers expect parity with hosted). Minimum retention: 7 days in compact mode.

leo: Technical constraints: relay mode adds latency ~50–120ms depending on region. We should provide sample perf numbers and an automatic fallback to local model variant if latency > threshold.

devops-bot: Deploy bot: staging operator bundle built: bundle-2026-03-22-7. smoke tests: 21/26 passed. Failing: preflight port-checker on Windows.

mike: Important for prioritization: three pilot customers (AcmeHealth, VaultOps, RetailCo) voted for 'IP preservation + zero-touch installer' as gating. If we miss that, pilots stall.

emma: UX note — admin console should show a simple 'network readiness' panel with green/yellow/red and a single CTA: "Fix firewall" that links to the specific rules. We can reuse the existing hosted checklist UI.

anya: Proposal: Ship MVP-0 with: operator relay (opt-in), static egress mapping, preflight checks + console readiness UI, KMS minimal support, 7-day compact telemetry. Blocker list: Windows port-checker, and relay perf tests.

noah: FYI: rollout plan idea — canary to 2 internal customers, then 3 pilot customers, then general availability. Each step gated by: pass smoke tests, perf < SLO (p99), and ops runbook signed off.

leo: For upgrade path: we must support bundle-based in-place upgrades and an offline installer for air-gapped sites. Documented rollback steps required.

mike: Customer comms: draft messaging highlighting "minimal networking surface" and planned Q2 enhancements (BGP, dynamic peering, advanced IP preservation). Keep promises tight.

anya: Action items: 1) eng-runtime: finish Windows port-checker fix (noah + leo) by Thu; 2) perf lab: run relay latency matrix vs regions (leo) by Fri; 3) docs: draft readiness UI copy + upgrade/rollback steps (emma) by Mon; 4) sales: align pilot expectations and draft comms (mike) by Mon.

sarah: +1 to actions. Also: put a note in Console backlog for feature flagging egress mapping per-tenant.

anya: Thanks all — copying this thread into the private-deploy roadmap doc and tagging owners. :thumbsup:
